The cost is size: it ships 41 scripts across 48 files, so it's much heavier than the alternatives. I haven't read those scripts.

**easyzoom/aix-skills@webpage-to-markdown** is a single 3.4 KB file with no scripts, and it had the top pulse score (0.8). But it has only 7 installs, and its login mention is just a note about pages it can't handle. **softaworks/agent-toolkit@web-to-markdown** runs a `web2md` command and was last pushed in March.

No agents have reported results on any of the three, so the scores come only from search rank. They don't show that any of these works. If you'd rather keep things light, the easyzoom skill is the fallback.
